subject: Flags to Turn off Charges in pmemd

messages.author: Sharif Nada
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I am trying to perform a run in pmemd with all elecrostatic
interactions turned off and I was wondering what the best way to do
this is. sander has a zerochg=0 flag to add to the debugf control list
but this command is not recognised by pmemd.
Thanks in advance for the help.
Sharif Nada
The University of Queensland
